effect.name: GM Granite
effect.desc: Five stone surfaces generated in layer space. Granite builds crystalline cells from a cellular noise field and drops mineral speckle on top, Marble runs a turbulent sine through the field to make veins, Sandstone lays down horizontal sedimentary bands, Basalt grows columnar joints, and Concrete is an octave stack with grit. A real bump normal is taken from the pattern's own gradient and lit from an adjustable angle, so the surface has relief instead of being a flat texture. Pattern scale, octaves, crystal size, speckle, vein strength, roughness and a source modulation are all separate controls.
